LESSON: STANDING FIRM IN FAITH

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.2: Standing firm in Faith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Standing firm in Faith
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should Christians stand firm in their faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the suffering faced by the Apostles according to 2 Corinthians 6:3-7
2. identify values/virtues in the life of Apostle Paul
3. apply values from the life of Apostle Paul in day-to-day life
